messages:
raj: Heads-up — requesting a new GPU nodepool in asia-south1 (India) for a mixed-batch workload spike test. Need guidance on sizing + quotas before I open a TF PR.

mira: +1. What GPU types are we considering? preemptible/spot ok?

raj: Thinking a small mixed pool: L4 for low-latency infer, A2 (or older v100 fallback) for heavy batching. Start with 6 L4 + 4 A2, autoscale 0-20 nodes. Preemptible for A2 to save cost; L4 should be sustained.

lin: FYI India region has lower GPU quota by default. We should check acceleratorQuota and CPUs. I'll check current quotas.

devops-bot: quota-check: project:redwood-inference - asia-south1 GPUs: L4: 0/0 (not requested), A2: 0/0. CPUs: 120/300. Request needed for GPUs and GPUs-per-region.

sre_lead: Also confirm VPC-native subnet IPs + NAT egress. If we autoscale to 20 nodes we need 20*podCIDR IPs or use VPC-NAT. Any heavy egress to third-party endpoints?

raj: No external egress expected for test; image pulls from our private registry (gcr). Will need imagePullSecrets. We'll use regional PD for shared checkpoints.

mira: Can you add taints so L4 nodes are dedicated for latency-critical pods? e.g. taint node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu:NoSchedule and label gpu-type=L4

raj: Yes — plan: label gpu-type=L4/A2 and taint gpu.workload=latency:NoSchedule on L4. Batch job tolerations on A2. Autoscaler config: --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m, --balance-similar-node-groups enabled.

lin: Quick cost estimate (very rough): L4 ~ $0.45/hr, A2 ~ $3.50/hr (on-demand). With 6 L4 + 4 A2 fully used ~ $16/hr on-demand; preemptible A2 cut to ~ $7/hr. Need finance signoff for sustained test budget. @finance-ops

finance-ops: Thanks for tagging — allocation OK up to $2000 for the test window. Please include exact TF diff before provisioning.

raj: Thanks. I'll open a quota ticket with cloud support and attach the TF diff. Anyone object to using preemptible A2?

mira: fine with preemptible as long as we have checkpointing and a fallback small on-demand lane. Also add pod disruption budget for stateful workers.

raj: Good call. I'll add a tiny on-demand A2 fallback pool (1-2 nodes) with lower GPU memory to catch critical jobs.

lin: I started the quota request (case 987654321). Requesting 10 L4 and 10 A2 GPUs in asia-south1 for trial. Cloud replied: "typical approval 48-72h".

devops-bot: deploy-sim: sample TF snippet for node pool (please review):
```hcl
resource "google_container_node_pool" "gpu_mixed_asia_south1" {
  name       = "gpu-mixed-asia-south1"
  location   = "asia-south1"
  node_count = 0
  autoscaling {
    min_node_count = 0
    max_node_count = 20
  }
  node_config {
    machine_type = "n2-standard-16"
    oauth_scopes = ["cloud-platform"]
    labels = { "gpu-type" = "mixed" }
    taints = [ { key = "gpu.workload", value = "latency", effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" } ]
    accelerator_config {
      accelerator_count = 1
      accelerator_type  = "NVIDIA-L4"
    }
  }
}
```

mira: Looks good. Make sure the GPU operator DaemonSet and driver installer run as a privileged Job in the pool. Add nodePool.annotations for maintenance windows.

raj: Will add installation steps to the PR and include k8s manifests:
```bash
kubectl apply -f gpu-operator.yaml --context=asia-south1
kubectl create secret docker-registry regcred --docker-server=gcr.io --docker-username=_json_key --docker-password="$JSON_KEY" --docker-email=ops@redwood.com
```

lin: Also confirm firewall egress to image registry and metrics endpoints (prometheus). I'll open a NSG change for asia-south1.

raj: OK I'll prepare TF, kube manifests, cost calc and post PR when quota case is updated. If cloud approves sooner we can flip the switch. :thumbsup:

mira: Thanks — tag me on the PR for taint/label verification.

finance-ops: Noted. Keep cost updates in the PR description.

raj: Closing for now, will update thread once case 987654321 progresses.
